dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave trailing edge with a smooth spline curvature extending from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a narrow pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 35-degree positive slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Measured at approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular arc with a moderate radius defining the forehead region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thickened beak geometry extending anteriorly from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, circular white depigmented lesion or scar is located on the upper flank, approximately one dorsal fin width anterior-ventral to the fin base; several faint linear rake marks are visible on the mid-lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly saturated cyan/teal chromaticity across the entire dorsal and lateral pixel area.
